crops.name: Banana
crops.note: TNAU planting windows vary by wetland, garden land, padugai land, hill site, and variety. The app does not have enough district/land-type data to rank banana for a selected district.
crops.soil_note: TNAU describes well-drained loamy soils as suitable and alkaline/saline soils as unsuitable; check the cited guidance for the selected variety.
crops.water_note: Planting and irrigation needs vary by variety and land type; no district-level water suitability is inferred.

crops.source_title: TNAU Coconut Planting Seasons and Climate
crops.note: TNAU describes Tamil Nadu planting windows of June–July and December–January, with other timing where irrigation is assured. No district-level recommendation is encoded here, so coconut is not ranked.
crops.water_note: Planting timing and long-term water availability need local assessment.
